solve_maxent_symmetric_nash: solve for the maxent symmetric Nash equilibrium of a symmetric two-player zero-sum game using convex programming
solve_maxent_symmetric_nash_avt: solve for the maxent symmetric Nash equilibrium of an agent-vs-task two-player zero-sum game using convex programming
compute_nash_averaging_avt_matrix: compute the agent-vs-task Nash averaging from a score matrix representing agents and tasks
compute_nash_averaging: compute the maxent Nash averaging for a two-player zero-sum game given a pyspiel game object
validate_zero_sum_game: validate that a game is a two-player zero-sum game before computing Nash averaging
